_classes.name: Passive or program subject stored with agency Unspecified instead of the named locality
_classes.rule: agency=='Unspecified' and actor_raw.lower()!='unspecified' (broad); narrow: agency=='Unspecified' and re.search(r'^(an? |the |such |all )?(notice|demonstration program|fines|penalt|local law|application|report|moneys|funds|program)', actor_raw.lower())
_classes.note: narrow rule: 10 matches (2009-A7329-03, -05, -06). 2009-A7329-11 'such county' and 2015-S5948-05 (named partnership) also Unspecified: resolver fails on 'such county' and on bodies not in the crosswalk. Known passive-subject class; this is a recurrence on the agency field.

_classes.name: Garbage agency_unit built from a capitalised verb or noun ('Entity County', 'Empower County')
Real enumerated powers or list-item duties and extension entries dropped by designation_no_actor
_classes.rule: over data/dropped/*.json: rule=='designation_no_actor' and (re.match(r'^To [a-z]+', quote) [71] or re.match(r'^(Assist|Serve|Support|Seek|Provide|Establish|Develop|Maintain|Coordinate|Promote|Encourage|Conduct|Prepare|Review|Advise)\b', quote) [14] or re.search(r'\buntil\b[^.;]{0,80}(two thousand|20\d\d)', quote, re.I) [27])
_classes.note: runs over dropped files, not duties/powers (these are misses). Sum of three sub-rules, overlap not removed. The gate keeps report-content list items out correctly (2009-A7329-12..19) but also drops subdivisions of a 'shall have the following powers' or 'duties of the office shall include' section, and species/date list entries whose lead-in is a power.

_classes.name: List item under a 'duties ... shall include' lead-in stored as power although rule and model both said duty
_classes.note: 74 of the 80 have kind_list_item true; some later override flips the stored kind against both classifiers.

_classes.name: extends_existing false on a record whose quote is mostly pre-existing text widened by a braced insertion
_classes.rule: extends_existing is False and 0 < (share of quote characters inside {{ }} in the packet text after removing [ ]) < 0.5
_classes.note: mechanical screen, will include some true negatives (a new sentence spliced into old text).

_classes.name: Reprinted existing duty or power stored where the only braced matter in the quote is gender wording or nothing, in an amended section
_classes.rule: quote located in packet text after removing [ ]; braced characters in the quote, minus 'or her/or she', contain no word; nearest section header says 'amended to read' or 'amended by adding' (not 'a new section/article')

_classes.name: Pre-existing actor kept as a record when braces only add a second actor to the same sentence
_classes.rule: none mechanical: needs the braced span to be matched to the actor phrase

_classes.name: Goal statement or litigation consequence stored as a record
_classes.rule: re.search(r'\bgoals?\b[^.]{0,40}\bmay include\b|deemed abandoned if', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: Local agency stored under its own name instead of the local group with the name in agency_unit
_classes.rule: re.search(r'\b(County|City|Town|Village)\b', agency) and agency not in (Counties, Cities, Towns, Villages) and jurisdiction!='nyc' and not re.search('New York City|NYC', agency)

_classes.name: Emergency or proviso powers and parallel content duties omitted by the model (no stored or dropped record)
